research_positioning: Random Forest is used as a conventional tree-based baseline.

target.name: etc_mm_day
target.kc_source: growth-stage curve built from the project's agronomic reference files; see config/crop_stages.yaml
target.statement: This target is derived from a physics reference applied to a real weather series. It is NOT an observed field measurement of water use. Any model trained on it learns and refines a reference-derived quantity, and results must be reported in those terms.
target.why_not_the_supplied_column: crop_water_data.csv -> water_requirement_liters was tested and rejected: the stated volumes imply irrigation depths about a hundred times smaller than the lightest real application, its evapotranspiration column is uncorrelated with all of its physical drivers simultaneously, all nine numeric columns are indistinguishable from uniform draws, and a log-linear model recovers 90 percent of its variance as a clipped multiplicative formula. See docs/dataset_analysis.md section 5.

feature_timing: All selected predictors are lagged one observation day within each crop/sowing-date cohort; the target is the following day's reference-derived ETc.

split.strategy: chronological split on target date; one-day-ahead features; 60% train, 20% validation, 20% test

hyperparameters.configuration_source: Preserves the approved ml.models.model_zoo random_forest baseline; sklearn's default max_features=1.0 is retained.

evaluation_target_note: Scores measure agreement with reference-derived FAO-56 ETc, not field-observed crop water use.
